claim: At launch (What's New post of Feb 14, 2025), CloudTrail network activity events for VPC endpoints could be enabled for five AWS services: Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, AWS KMS, AWS Secrets Manager and AWS CloudTrail.
note: Launch-time list only: the current CloudTrail guide lists many more services that support network activity events (currency vote 2026-10-23). The CloudTrail document history lists general availability on February 13, 2025 (row 'General availability of network activity events'); the What's New post is dated Feb 14, 2025. Current pricing: cloudtrail-pricing-network-activity-events-per-100000.
